sources.title: litert-community/LFM2-700M · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LFM2-700M has 742,489,344 parameters in 16 layers (10 convolution + 6 attention); Liquid AI lists English, Arabic, Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Korean and Spanish and states a 32,768-token context (4096 in these files).
